primary_sources.title: Kishimoto and Muller, A General Solution to the Graph History Interaction Problem (AAAI 2004)
primary_sources.use: Why path-dependent draws make indiscriminate board-only score reuse unsafe; not proof our prototypes implement the paper's general solution.

primary_sources.title: Stockfish search, pinned source
primary_sources.use: Primary example of coordinated TT, PVS/reductions, pruning and GHI/rule50 safeguards. Do not copy its parameters or attribute strength to one feature.

primary_sources.title: Pinned Sacrifice search
primary_sources.use: Local pin inspected: PVS, LMR, history ordering, aspiration, TT and quiescence. Its history ordering is distinct from repetition history.

primary_sources.title: Pinned Sacrifice evaluation
primary_sources.use: Mobility, king shelter, activity, center and attack evaluation; historical Tal style affects root ordering rather than positional score.

primary_sources.title: Stockfish NNUE training project
primary_sources.use: Primary route for understanding trained evaluation/data tooling. NNUE is a separate architectural option, not an implemented or measured gain here.

primary_sources.title: Fishtest mathematics
primary_sources.use: Distinguish small fixed-size screens from statistical strength tests and paired sequential testing.

primary_sources.title: Fishtest FAQ
primary_sources.use: Uncertainty and interactions prevent adding feature Elo guesses or comparing noisy historical point estimates as exact effects.

observations: The library already uses bitboards and a mailbox; it is inaccurate to frame the gap as no bitboards.
ValidMoves returns a defensive copy; ValidMovesUnsafe is read-only and must never be sorted in place.
Status can generate a first legal move before full move generation later; legality/check tags simulate each candidate on a temporary board.
